label: Aquinas on actual understanding and its limits across knowers
summary: I q.14 a.4 gives actually exercised understanding for God. Q.14 a.2 expressly allows a human intellect in potency to understanding and locates actual exercise in its being informed, so neither article warrants attributing the unrestricted intellect-to-exercise premise to Aquinas. Its actual/potential contrast is evidence for a reading of the separate capacity disjunction, without settling the independent potency predicate. Q.12 a.4 concerns the limit of natural power and expressly admits elevation by grace. Q.7 a.2 distinguishes absolute from qualified infinity in creatures. Q.16 a.5 ad 1 gives simple divine knowledge of complex contents, alongside the body's identification of God with first truth.
blocker: Fix the natural versus elevated knower and justify the common act and knowing scales before importing degree bounds. In the veracity interface identify the carrier for complex intelligibles and justify the Present mapping. For unrestricted actual understanding distinguish capacity from current operation.
